architecture.database: Supabase PostgreSQL; ordered SQL migrations in supabase/migrations
architecture.deployment: Next.js standalone output; Dockerfile/docker-compose and GitHub Actions are present. No live deployment provider or production environment was verified.
architecture.rendering: Localized App Router pages use a mix of Server and Client Components; SEO metadata stays server-side.

confirmedFlows: Application API validates a candidate role and active, unexpired job; database uniqueness and application-count trigger are defined by migrations.
Search repository queries active Supabase job_posts, but the localized search and detail pages still use sample job data.
Employer listing form currently stores draft/publish state in localStorage rather than a persistent API.

validation.build: npm run build; acquire board build lock; use an isolated registered worktree whose tracked and untracked inputs match the current working tree
validation.testScript: No project-wide test script is defined in package.json.
validation.e2e: Playwright MCP is available; browser access depends on valid local runtime environment.

orchestration.safety: Cline is configured for read-only review; the installed URI handler inherits the current Plan/Act mode, and the adapter rejects write, execution, or unknown-tool transcripts before judgment. OpenCode commit/push are denied; Chief-only commits; lock, retry, evidence, recovery, idempotency, and secret redaction are implemented. Operator reports Cline read-only + Deep Plan selected; a fresh session transcript is still pending.

ownership.cline: Read-only reviewer; never writes or executes.

knownRisks.description: A browser smoke test of localhost:3000/tr/ilan-ara failed with a client-side OrtamYapilandirmaHatasi because NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL is missing or invalid in the running dev server.
Candidate search/detail still uses sample listings while the application endpoint queries real job_posts.
Employer publish flow only writes localStorage; entitlement, company membership, moderation, and persistence rules must be reconciled before API implementation.
Search API accepts filters not implemented by its repository; some code/enum and multi-district mappings are inconsistent.
Payment webhook order/event/invoice/subscription writes are not atomic; refund matching and state transitions need provider semantics.
Application form carries contact fields and a local CV filename; application schema persists neither contact PII nor an uploaded CV reference.
